profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at DIRECTV
profile.jobTitle: Principal Software Engineer/ Dev Lead, React Native
profile.summary: A motivated and experienced software developer designing and implementing business solutions while solving complex problems using entrepreneurial skills coupled with technical experience.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer/ Dev Lead, React Native
Lead React Native Developer (Contract)
positions.description:
Implemented Android first react native app to display high-frequency data from IoT sensors as well as AI-driven alert and monitoring system.
Integrated Apollo Queries, Mutations, Resolvers and local state management using custom types, resolvers, and mutations.
Implemented charts to present IoT sensor data.
Achieved high code quality through Typescripts, lint, and reusable components.
Implemented high performance components using Pure components and extensive MR reviews.
Developed custom client-side PDF generation system that generates pdf from HTML and CSS.

positions.title: CTO/Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a CTO/Software Engineer at Mojiit Inc, I developed a large portion of the mobile app as well as back end including UI, 3D character management, 3D renders, GIF creation and optimization, NodeJS server with MongoDB, AWS Lambda Functions, React Admin panel. I also handle Scalable server deployment and App Store releases. 

Mojiit was ranked top 40 in the US App store, in just a week of release. It's a hybrid app built with Unity3D and IOS native built to deliver high-quality 3D character customization and porting your customized character in form of Animated GIF. These animated GIFS can be sent using our standard IOS App, iMessage app and keyboard inside iMessage or any other social media platform.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer and Project Manager
positions.description:
•Responsible for coding the execution of complex designs and user interface interactions that reflect     the creative and artistic direction provided within the technical framework.
• Keeping a pulse on trends in the industry and identify/implement technical innovations.
• Mentoring co-workers to help them develop advanced technical and leadership knowledge.
• Develop IOS and Android applications using AngularJs and ionic framework.
• Work closely with clients to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Creatively analyzed and solved complex interface, design and programming issues while considering system limitations.
• Embraced emerging standards while prompting best practices in order to push the limits of what a browser can do.
• Integrated third party products into internal systems as well as support and upgrade implemented systems.
• Collaborated with colleagues in technical and non-technical roles throughout each project’s lifecycle, from concept to timely execution.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
• Established a well reputed business of delivering customized I.T solutions. Executed highest quality software development standards and customer service experience.
• Actively managed and participate through development life cycle of all the projects.
• Started as developing corporate websites. Over the time shifted focus on customized ERP systems and internal management systems.

educations.schoolName: parul institute of engineering and technology

projects.title: SWYK
projects.description:
Developed IOS and Android Hybrid app using Ionic and Cordova framework with AngularJS, NodeJS, Neo4j and other latest technology.
Established the software architecture and implemented software design concepts to achieve scalability and performance. 
Implemented important features such as In-app calling and stripe payments with auto payments to providers(Guides). 
So far App has won following competition:
1) Wonder Women Tech Conference #investinaboss Winner – Long Beach, CA - July 2016 
2) SBA & Microsoft InnovateHER Regional Semi-Finalist Winner – Costa Mesa, CA -December 2015

projects.title: Bill and Client Record System
projects.description:
This web application is specially developed for Patson Machine Tools, Makarpura. This system having functionality focusing on keeping record of client and their purchase with detail description of product and searching bill detail, product and client detail in different ways.

It is developed in JSP with Hibernate. Database is developed in MYSQL. For searching ajax and JSON in used to increase performance.
